title: 第1162章 吃剑老魔第1161章 灭果师
content_zh:
明月高悬
魔眼宗
凌天剑阁
一袭黑袍，长发披散，腰悬一柄血红长剑的中年男子负手伫立在楼台边，一张形似猿猴的丑陋脸庞带着淡淡笑意
在其脚边正盘腿坐着个紫袍老者，在其头顶之上一柄血色小剑静静盘旋
“都说紫金派掌门是位剑道天才，如今看来一点不假，如此浓厚的剑意，看来他悟到了某种剑之大道了”
黑袍男子咧嘴轻笑露出两排血色般的尖牙
此人正是魔眼宗大长老血海魔君肖芳，他除了一身血道魔功无人能敌外，还酷爱吞食天下名剑，尤其是修士所孕养而出的剑意，故而人送外号【吃剑老魔】
而此刻坐在他脚边的自然便是杨威了，他已经被送到这里足有七日
在刚见到杨威之时这位吃剑老魔可谓欣喜若狂，就如同急需滋补的人碰见了千年老
立即便从薛闵圭，禹坤手中花费大价钱买下了此人
只不过与往常不同的是肖芳并没有立马选择将杨威给吞了
反而给他提供了一个绝对安静的环境，让他静养在自己的剑阁之中
每日甚至安排剑侍在其周围舞剑为其提供悟性上的辅助
今日又是一曲落下，剑仙子们鱼贯而出，原地只留一道飘然若仙的青裙身影好似翩翩飞舞的蝴蝶缓缓落在舞台的中心
此女梳着个飞仙髻斜斜插着三根金缕步摇，柳眉凤目玉容赛雪，身穿一袭青绿锦绣华服气质清冷的好似不食人间烟火
“这都过去这般多日，还是一点反应也没有，夫君，你说他会不会早就是个活死人了”
青衣女子玉手一转雪白宝剑归入窍中，一双美眸打量着仿佛气息全无的老者
只见在其苍老的面庞此刻正凝结出一颗颗如老人般一样的黑点，这是尸斑说明老者已然处于生死未知的状态
“呵呵，夫人勿虑，此剑意如此浑厚，怎么可能是个毫无思想的活死人凝聚而出，依我看定是剑意太强已经反噬了此人意志”

肖芳到底在剑道上远超道侣，当即便说出了自己的见解
“嗯，若真死了，我等便亏大了，给了少主三瓶血煞丹，给了五长老一面血魔幡……
“好了，何必计较那般多？我辈修士欲求大道还要惜财岂不可笑？
“只要这道剑意一成，肖某说不得便可更进一步成就一番剑道之上的造化，等到那时一切也就都值得了”
肖芳始终双手背在身后，手中盘着一串只有十二颗的骷髅珠子脑袋轻晃冷笑道
“这老头子倒真是个弄潮儿，甚至有三方巨头之一的架势，这次龙子登科可没少出风头，夫君还需小心谨慎才是”
青衣女子走上前来挽住肖芳的胳膊轻声道
“哼……一个老不死罢了，翻不起什么风浪，如今龙子已死，龙子登科彻底失败，一切尘埃落定，都已不足为虑”
肖芳冷哼一声笑道
“夫君说的是，是妾身多心了”
青衣女子抿唇轻笑微抬螓首望着天际，此刻明月浮在云海之间周围荡起阵阵波澜
“夫人有事要与老夫说？
见道侣如此小鸟依人，肖芳却不解风情道
“哪有……难道夫君忘了，当初答应过妾身的事了？
青衣女子柳眉微挑娇嗔道
“哦？何事？老夫这才出关没几日”
肖芳故作茫然道
“就是水王的事呀，他不是已经死了吗，那【长流水】便空了出来，妾身便想……
青裙女子翻了个好看的白眼道，一双柔荑轻轻抚摸着肖芳鬓角的白发
“此事不急，来日方长“

肖芳摆了摆手道
“来日，可就来不及了啊”
青裙女子心中一叹，面上却只能强颜欢笑
content_en:
The bright moon hangs high
Magic Eye Sect
Lingtian sword pavilion
A middle-aged man wearing a black robe, with long hair disheveled, and a blood-red sword hanging from his waist, stood by the balcony with his hands behind his hands, an ugly ape-like face with a faint smile.
An old man in purple robes sat cross-legged at his feet, and a small bloody sword hovered quietly above his head.
"It is said that the leader of the Purple Gold Sect is a swordsman genius, and it seems to be true now. With such a strong sword intention, it seems that he has realized some kind of sword art."
The man in black robe smiled softly, revealing two rows of blood-colored fangs.
This person is the Blood Sea Demon Lord Xiao Fang, the great elder of the Demon Eye Sect. In addition to his unrivaled blood magic skills, he also loves to devour famous swords in the world, especially the sword intent conceived by monks, so he is nicknamed "Old Sword-eating Demon"
And the person sitting at his feet at this moment is naturally Yang Wei. He has been sent here for seven days.
When he first met Yang Wei, the old sword-eating demon was ecstatic, just like someone who was in urgent need of nourishment when he met a thousand-year-old man.
He immediately bought this person from Xue Mingui and Yu Kun at a large price.
But what was different from usual was that Xiao Fang did not immediately choose to swallow Yang Wei.
Instead, it provided him with an absolutely quiet environment, allowing him to rest in his own sword pavilion.
Every day, sword attendants are even arranged to dance swords around him to provide him with intellectual assistance.
Another song fell today, and the sword fairies filed out, leaving only a figure in a green skirt that seemed to be flying like a fairy, slowly landing in the center of the stage like a fluttering butterfly.
This girl wears a flying fairy bun with three golden strands inserted sideways. She has willow eyebrows and phoenix eyes and a jade-like face. She wears a green and splendid embroidered dress and has a cool temperament, as if she can't eat the fireworks of the world.
"It's been so many days and there's still no reaction at all. Husband, do you think he might have been a living dead long ago?"
The woman in green turned her snow-white sword into her orifice with her jade hand, and looked at the old man who seemed to have no breath at all with her beautiful eyes.
I saw that his old face was now condensed with black spots like an old man. These were corpse spots, indicating that the old man was in a state of unknown life and death.
"Haha, madam, don't worry, this sword intention is so strong, how could it be condensed from a living dead without any thought? In my opinion, the sword intention is too strong and has backfired on this person's will."
After all, Xiao Fang is far superior to his fellow Taoists in the way of swordsmanship, and even though he expressed his opinion
"Well, if he really dies, we will suffer a big loss. We gave the young master three bottles of Blood Demon Pills and gave the Fifth Elder a Blood Demon Banner...
"Okay, why bother worrying so much? Isn’t it ridiculous for monks like us to cherish wealth even if we desire the great path?
"As long as this sword intention is completed, Xiao will be able to further achieve something beyond the sword, and then everything will be worth it."
Xiao Fang always had her hands behind her back, holding a string of only twelve skull beads, shaking her head and sneering.
"This old man is really a trend-setter. He even has the posture of one of the three giants. This time Longzi is in the limelight when he is admitted to the imperial examination. Husband, you need to be careful."
The woman in green came forward and took Xiao Fang's arm and said softly
"Hmph... He's just an old man who can't make any trouble. Now that Long Zi is dead, Long Zi's admission to the imperial examinations has completely failed. Everything has settled and there is nothing to worry about."
Xiao Fang snorted and laughed.
"My husband is saying that I am too preoccupied."
The woman in green clothes pursed her lips and smiled slightly, raising her head and looking at the sky. At this moment, the bright moon was floating among the sea of clouds, making waves around her.
"Madam, do you have something to tell me?
Seeing the Taoist couple being so attached to each other, Xiao Fang couldn't understand the charming Taoism.
"How can there be...has your husband forgotten that he promised to be my concubine?
The woman in green clothes raised her eyebrows and said coquettishly
"Oh? What's the matter? I've only been out of seclusion for a few days."
Xiao Fang pretended to be confused and said
"It's about the Water King. Isn't he already dead? Then the [Long Flowing Water] will be free, and I thought...
The woman in the green skirt rolled her eyes and said, gently stroking Xiao Fang's white hair on her temples with a pair of catkins.
"There's no rush, there's a long way to go"
Xiao Fang waved her hand and said
"It will be too late tomorrow."
The woman in the green skirt sighed in her heart, but she could only force a smile on her face.
